scope: Only server/origin-cloud.ts and server/origin-cloud.test.ts changed. No push, production operations, real account requests, local Convex process, or user data used.

findings.scenario: An older DELETE snapshots expired A and awaits its owner lookup. PUT B verifies B and expires A, then writes B. Resolving the old A lookup as signed out lets the old DELETE erase B.
findings.fix: Snapshot the exact deployment URL and token checked; reject changed ownership with409 before the synchronous write.

findings.scenario: An older PUT C awaits verification of expired stored A. A newer PUT B verifies and writes B first. The old A lookup resolves signed out and the older PUT overwrites B with C.
findings.fix: Apply the same URL-and-token comparison before PUT and retain the current project-link map.

findings.scenario: Two distinct deployment URLs issue the same token text to different accounts. The token-only shortcut skips the signed-in owner and replaces it.
findings.fix: Only treat a candidate as already verified when both deployment URL and token match.

findings.scenario: The stored owner lookup fails. Mapping that transport error to an empty owner lets PUT or DELETE mutate an account whose ownership was never verified.
findings.fix: Return a generic502 and preserve the stored account on owner verification failure.
